post.summary: Record an immutable WBS read-only snapshot observation
post.description: This creates evidence in REFS only. It never writes WBS, source documents, journal entries or ledger lines. Production snapshots require a verified detached Ed25519 signature from a pinned IT key.

get.summary: List authoritative Journal Entries for the authenticated entity
List authoritative read-only bank transaction evidence
get.description: Returns only authenticated tenant/entity/account-scoped bank source and latest match evidence. This operation cannot match, clear, sign off, or post.

post.summary: Match a bank transaction to exact POSTED payment evidence
post.description: Creates one audited active match between the bank transaction and an authoritative POSTED AP payment or AR receipt after exact entity, account, direction, currency, amount, date, source, revision, and ledger-line checks. This command does not create, modify, approve, or post a journal entry.

post.summary: Unmatch an active bank-payment evidence link
post.description: Ends exactly one ACTIVE bank match after authenticated scope, match revision, idempotency, bank-source identity, and review-reason checks. Immutable Journal Entry, ledger, source-link, audit, and prior match evidence are retained. This command does not reverse, modify, approve, or post a journal entry.

get.summary: Read an authoritative reconciliation statement evidence summary
get.description: Returns only the live DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, or REOPENED reconciliation worksheet for the exact account and statement ending date. Activity starts after the latest prior RECONCILED statement; historical RECONCILED rows are not dynamically recomputed or returned. This read cannot match, clear, reopen, sign off, or post.

get.summary: Read authoritative financial statements from POSTED ledger evidence
get.description: Returns entity-and-period-scoped Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and direct cash movement rows. Account classification is explicit and every row carries immutable journal, ledger, and source drill identifiers. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, export, or persist a report.

post.summary: Start one scoped bank statement reconciliation
post.description: Creates one Draft reconciliation from an authenticated entity, exact bank account, statement cutoff, opening balance, ending balance and review reason. It cannot create or post a Journal Entry.

post.summary: Clear or unclear one exact matched statement item
post.description: Applies optimistic concurrency to both reconciliation and bank evidence. Only an exact ACTIVE match may be cleared; signed-off evidence is immutable.

post.summary: Clear or unclear one Posted adjustment-backed statement item
post.description: Applies optimistic concurrency to one immutable Posted adjustment Draft and its exact statement bank source. It never matches a payment or creates, approves, or posts a Journal Entry; signed-off evidence is immutable.

post.summary: Review, sign off, or reopen one reconciliation
post.description: Review requires complete exact Posted payment-match or adjustment evidence and zero difference. Sign-off requires a distinct actor and writes an immutable snapshot. Reopen requires a distinct actor; no Journal Entry is created or posted.

get.summary: List exact POSTED AP-payment or AR-receipt candidates for one bank source
get.description: This is a controller-only, read-only candidate selection. Each row already has the exact entity, currency, signed amount, bank account, date-window, POSTED Journal Entry, Journal Line, Ledger Line, and no-active-match predicates required by Bank Match. It never creates a match, alters a payment, or posts a Journal Entry. Zero or multiple rows require the controller to stop; no match command is implied.

post.summary: Create one reconciliation-linked Draft Journal Entry
post.description: Creates only a balanced, attachment-backed MANUAL Draft for one exact unresolved statement bank source in an open reconciliation. The one bank-account line must resolve both that source amount and the current statement difference. It cannot submit, approve, or post the Journal Entry; normal JE workflow and a post-time reconciliation guard remain required.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated entity’s current DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, or REOPENED worksheet. It exposes bank evidence, the exact ACTIVE match when present, and clearance audit state; it cannot create a match, clear an item, review, sign off, reopen, or post.

snapshot.description: WBS_READONLY_SNAPSHOT_V1 package. The runtime validates package hashes, one WBS company scope, stable GuId keys, and production detached-signature requirements.

ETag.description: Strong revision validator when the created resource has an authoritative revision

CommandReplay.description: Idempotent replay of a completed command

ETag.description: Strong revision validator when the replayed resource has an authoritative revision

AttachmentReplay.description: Idempotent replay of a completed attachment command

BusinessAdjustmentReadOk.description: Authenticated AP/AR adjustment and linked Journal Entry read

Problem.description: Fail-closed command error; stale revision preconditions are 412 and exhausted database serialization retries are 503

Retry-After.description: Present only for retryable 503 serialization exhaustion responses, in seconds

BankMatchCandidateReadOk.description: Scoped, controller-authorized exact POSTED bank-match candidates
